spanish: Si ha nacido el sol sobre él, sangres a él; pagando pagará; si no hay a él, y será vendido en su hurto.

findings.issue: «ha nacido» adds birth; H2224 is qal perfect 3fs rise/shine, with the sun as subject.

notes: The rest stays inside the tokens: plural sangres, לוֹ, the doubled piel, אין לו, niphal sale, and ב plus his theft.
